out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the @LOCATION@ being used @OBSERVATION@. - OBSERVED: kitchen hand sink was used to store a water pitcher.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: CFM removed the water pitcher.

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The handwashing sink at @LOCATION@ is equipped with separate cold and hot water faucets rather than a mixing valve or combination faucet. - OBSERVED: kitchen hand sink hot water temperature is 66f. Service line hand sink hot water temperature is 92f.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: please obtain urgent service for the two hand sinks within 10 calendar days.

out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: - OBSERVED: a food employee used a piece of wet wiping cloth to wipe a knife for future use which was used to trim meat.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: EHS instructed CFM to properly wash, rinse and sanitize the knife.

out_items.name: Proper hot holding temperatures

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: - OBSERVED: cooked spinach (112f) and cooked potatoes (120f) were stored in Wells 2-drawer hot box for 2 hours.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: cooked spinach was reheated to 188f, and cooked potatoes were reheated to 178f. GRILL KABOB (Inspection Date: 05/08/2026) Page 2 of 4

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: - OBSERVED: cut lettuce (58f) in several takeout boxes were stored on a storage rack at service line for about 30 minutes.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: CFM relocated the takeout boxes in 2-door prep cooler.

out_items.name: Food properly labeled, original container

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: - OBSERVED: dry yeast was stored in a container without proper labeling.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: EHS instructed CFM to properly label the container.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. - OBSERVED: fresh rodent droppings were observed in dry storage areas.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: please obtain urgent pest control service within 10 calendar days.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Ice As Coolant Not Used as Food
violations.observation: Ice used as a medium for cooling the exterior surfaces of food is also for beverage ice or used as food. - OBSERVED: a can of soda was stored in directly inside the ice machine.
violations.corrective_action: After use as a medium for cooling the exterior surfaces of food, packaged foods, beverages, or cooling coils/tubes, the ice may not be used as food. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: CFM relocated the soda and removed the contaminated ice.

out_items.name: Personal cleanliness

violations.title: Hair Restraints
violations.observation: Employees observed working in the food service area without proper hair restraints. - OBSERVED: two food employees trimming meat without proper hair restraints.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wear hair restraints such as hats, visors, hair nets or beard nets to effectively keep their hair from contacting exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service items. This section does not apply to food employees such as counter staff who ONLY serve beverages and wrapped or packaged foods, hostesses, and wait staff. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: EHS instructed CFM to provide hair restraints for the food employees.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter. - OBSERVED: a piece of wiping clothes was stored on prep table.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: CFM stored the wiping clothes in sanitizer solution.

out_items.name: Plumbing installed, proper backflow devices

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. - OBSERVED: the atmospheric vacuum breaker on the mop sink is damaged.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: please replace the atmospheric vacuum breaker within 3 calendar days.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the @Physical structure@ in the @Location@ is in need of cleaning. - OBSERVED: fresh rodent droppings throughout the dry storage areas.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: EHS instructed CFM to perform a deep cleaning and increase cleaning frequency.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The handwashing sink at @LOCATION@ is equipped with separate cold and hot water faucets rather than a mixing valve or combination faucet. HOT WATER TEMPERATURE AT KITCHEN HAND SINK AND FRONT HAND SINK WAS 62F AND 94F, RESPECTIVELY.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. PLEASE OBTAIN URGENT SERVICE FOR THE TWO HAND SINKS WITHIN 10 CALENDAR DAYS.

out_items.name: Proper hot holding temperatures

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: COOKED POTATO (125- 128F) WAS STORED IN HOT BOX FOR ABOUT 2 HOURS.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CFM REHEATED THE POTATO TO 200F.

out_items.name: Washing fruits and vegetables

violations.title: Raw Produce Washed before Use
violations.observation: Vegetables are not washed before being offered for sale or service. RED CABBAGE WAS SHREDDED AND STORED IN COOLERS FOR SERVICE WITHOUT WASHING.
violations.corrective_action: Raw vegetables shall be thoroughly washed in water to remove soil and other contaminants before being cut, combined with other ingredients, cooked, served, or offered for human consumption in a ready-to-eat form. EHS EDUCATED THE CFM.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: THE FAUCET FOR COLD WATER AT 3-COMPARTMENT SINK IS DEFECTIVE.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2.

out_items.name: Plumbing installed, proper backflow devices

violations.title: Air Gaps/Breaks
violations.observation: An air gap between the water supply outlet and the flood rim level AT 3-COMPARTMENT SINK is not observed.
violations.corrective_action: An air gap between the water supply inlet and the flood level rim of the plumbing fixture, equipment, or nonfood equipment shall be at least twice the diameter of the water supply inlet and may not be less than one inch. PLEASE OBTAIN URGENT SERVICE FOR THE 3-COMPARTMENT SINK WITHIN 3 CALENDAR DAYS.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: The sink basin at the FRONT HAND SINK is slow to drain.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. GRILL KABOB (Inspection Date: 11/14/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: DOK Cooking Temp
violations.observation: THE CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER (CFM) failed to state the minimum cook temperatures and times for time/temperature control for BEEF KABOB, LAMB KABOB, AND CHICKEN KABOB.
violations.corrective_action: The person in charge shall know the cook temperatures for the following foods: 1) Poultry, turkey, stuffed foods, or duck shall be cooked to an internal temperatures of 165F or above instantaneously, 2) Comminuted meat/fish, mechanically tenderized meats or raw eggs not prepared for immediate service shall be cooked to an internal temperature of 155F for at least 17 seconds and 3) Pork, seafood, and eggs for immediate service shall be cooked to an internal temperature of 145F for at least 15 seconds. EHS EDUCATED THE CFM.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. EHS PROVIDED BOTH ENGLISH AND SPANISH COPIES OF THE PROCEDURE.

violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. CFM RELOCATED THE STORAGE RACK.

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The handwashing sink at @LOCATION@ is equipped with separate cold and hot water faucets rather than a mixing valve or combination faucet. HOT WATER AT KITCHEN HAND SINK AT 71F.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. PLEASE OBTAIN URGENT SERVICE FOR THE HAND SINK AND FORWARD ITS SERVICE REPORT TO EHS WITHIN 10 CALENDAR DAYS.

out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.observation: Surfaces of ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment are not being cleaned as required. OBSERVED MOLD BUILD UP INSIDE ICE MACHINE.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food
violations.observation: A review of the menu with the foodservice operator indicates that there is no consumer advisory for the following food item(s) that may be served raw and/or undercooked: BEEF KABOB AND LAMB KABOB.
violations.corrective_action: If an animal food such as beef, eggs, fish, lamb, milk, pork, poultry, or shellfish is served or sold raw or undercooked the permit holder shall inform consumers of the significantly increased risk of consuming such foods by way of a disclosure and reminder using brochures, deli case or menu advisories, label statements, table tents, placards, or other effective written means. PLEASE ADD A CONSUMER ADVISORY FOR BEEF KABOB AND LAMB KABOB ON THE MENU.

violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

out_items.name: Hot and cold water available, adequate pressure

violations.title: Hot Water Capacity to Meet Peak Demands
violations.observation: The existing water heater (Make: Eemax, Model: EEM24027, 27KW input) does not have the capacity to meet the hourly peak hot water demands of the food establishment. The current peak hot water demand is 3.8 gph of 120F water at a 80F rise.
violations.corrective_action: Within 30 days, the permit holder shall replace or upgrade the water heater with a unit that meets the following design and capacity requirements: (1) Commercial grade, (2) Minimum of 50 gallon storage tank, (3) Minimum recovery rate of 45gph of 120F water at a 80F rise@, and (4) Specifications and installation meet National Sanitation Foundation (NSF) Standard 5. The permit holder shall provide the Health Department with the specifications (cut sheet) for the replacement water heater and obtain approval prior to purchase and installation. Please be reminded that equipment replacement or addition is not allowed without prior approval by the Health Department. GRILL KABOB (Inspection Date: 05/19/2025) Page 2 of 4

out_items.name: Certified Food Protection Manager

violations.title: Food Manager Certificate & Responsibility
violations.observation: There is no Certified Food Manager present in the establishment.
violations.corrective_action: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager. It is highly suggested that you have more than one employee with the food manager's license. ORS Interactive, Inc. (see handout provided) issues the required photo identification card with proof of successful completion of a certified food manager's exam. Failure to have a certified food manager on site during ALL hours of operation including food preparation, food service, and cleaning/sanitizing of equipment/utensils will result in closure of the establishment.
